title: Reliquary
description: Admin tool to inspect chests item activity directly in-game.
body:
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23ddaf139cfad569df5bacc80682b68f48de0fbd.png)## 
**Reliquary** is a simple admin utility that shows who interacted with container items.

It lets admins quickly check:
- who **took items**
- who **put items**
- and **when** it happened

All information is shown directly in chat using `/co inspect`.

### Features
- Inspect container activity in-game
- Logs item take / put actions
- Clean and readable chat output
- Read-only inspect mode

### Compatibility
- Purpur / Paper
- Minecraft 1.21.x

### Notes
- This plugin is not an anti-grief or rollback system.
- It is designed to be lightweight and transparent.
